agent_report.summary: Fixed Issue #48: gave `.week-day.is-today` a non-colour cue (border-width 2px/3px alongside font-weight, distinct from `is-selected`'s existing channels — all four today/selected combinations now produce distinct computed tuples) and unified `#jump-date-input`, `#commitment-time-input` and `#deadline-due-input` with the text inputs' shared height/padding/border/radius/font/focus-ring rule (native date/time controls needed an explicit `height`, not just padding, since their internal chrome adds ~2px). Promoted the jump-date label from `sr-only` to visible meta text using the existing `jumpDateLabel` catalogue key. Added 9 new Playwright tests covering all acceptance criteria; full suite (149 tests) passes. Updated DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #49 on branch `ant/issue-48`, closing #48.
